11. Jim says that in the Iron Age village
options: A he is sometimes cold at night.
B he always gets up early.

correctAnswers.11: B he always gets up early.

questions.instruction:
Questions 11–15
Choose the correct answer.
Re-creating life in an Iron Age village

questions.text: 12. What does Jim say about the food they eat in the village?
options: A It takes time to prepare.
B It is difficult to get used to.
C It has to be eaten quickly.

correctAnswers.12: A It takes time to prepare.

questions.text: 13. Jim says that at the evening meal
options: A they are sometimes too tired to eat.
B they mainly have fruit and berries.
C they talk about what they've done.

correctAnswers.13: C they talk about what they've done.

questions.text: 14. The most important job for the blacksmiths is
options: A to mend broken tools and implements.
B to maintain a good source of heat.

correctAnswers.14: B to maintain a good source of heat.

questions.text: 15. Jim likes the fact that in the village, people
options: C get a lot of exercise.

questions.text: Mark centre of planned house with a {blank:16} ↓ Mark out circle for outer boundary ↓ Dig ground using tools made from {blank:17} ↓ Insert wall posts (Iron Age builders preferred wood from oak trees) ↓ Slot more stakes into upright posts ↓ Insert centre post and build a wooden {blank:18} around it ↓ Add main supporting beams and ring beams ↓ Complete roof framework using {blank:19} wood rods ↓ Cover roof with reed bundles of {blank:20} lengths ↓ Daub with mixture of clay, dung and straw A bone B different C equal D elm E hazel F iron G peg H roof I scaffold SECTION 3
21. What do the students find surprising about the way that complaints were dealt with at the call centre?
options: A the way that customers responded to it

questions.instruction:
Questions 21–24
Choose the correct answer.
Presentation on how jobs might change in the future

questions.text: 22. What does Emma say about the report by Jerry Kaplan?
options: A It shows how machines will respond to human needs.
B It emphasises the variety of roles that machines will have.
C It explains the limitations of machines.

correctAnswers.22: C It explains the limitations of machines.

questions.text: 23. What is Nick's reaction to the article The Human Cloud?
options: A He agrees that companies should focus on making savings.
B He supports the concept of greater flexibility for employees.
C He approves of businesses spending more on recruiting experts.

correctAnswers.23: B He supports the concept of greater flexibility for employees.

questions.text: 24. What do the students agree about the use of technology to collect information about employees?
options: A Cameras are an effective means of maintaining security.
B Sometimes productivity is more important than individual privacy.
C Employees may object to certain types of monitoring.

correctAnswers.24: C Employees may object to certain types of monitoring.
